purpose: Prevent future packages from disguising low-pressure integer betting as strict single-hit return betting; enforce combo debt relay language and advanced-state design.

combo_debt_relay_contract.requires_explicit_boundary: Must say this is not strict single-hit return betting unless every valid level proves full recovery.

advanced_betting_state_graph_contract.soft_reset_definition: At least one state with multiplier >= 3 has 中后ID greater than 1 and lower than current ID, so a win lowers pressure without always returning to base.
advanced_betting_state_graph_contract.cooling_definition: At least one rescue high-pressure state has 挂后ID pointing to a lower or low-pressure cooling state instead of unbounded escalation.
